snippet.title: Irondrive Demo - Pre Alpha Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Irondrive is a top-down vehicular roguelike where you manage a crew, 
repair systems under fire, and make permanent decisions on a post-apocalyptic road.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4599730/Irondrive/
🕹️ Play the Demo on itch.io → https://alessandrolemura.itch.io/irondrive
🕹️ Play the Demo on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4599730/Irondrive/
💬 Join the Discord → https://discord.gg/NNWJP6rRAQ

───────────────────────────────
This is a pre-alpha gameplay trailer. Features and visuals are subject to change.

#irondrive #indiegame #roguelike #gamedev #godotengine #survivalgame #indiegamedev
